about_the_game:
Scionide is a fast-paced sci-fi action shooter set in the war-torn future of the Scion Conflict universe. In the year 2268 AD, humanity is fractured. The Amalgamate Republic, a shattered alliance of frontier colony words fighting for freedom, makes its final stand against the Scion Empire, a militarized regime led by the ruthless Duntana, alien hybrid daughter of the Scion Emperor. As the war rages across the Milky Way, shadowy forces maneuver behind the scenes, seeking to seize control of humanity’s destiny.

Engage in intense battles across diverse environments, whether in single-player, PvP, or co-op PvE modes. Play on expansive maps, fighting against AI or other players in adrenaline-fueled combat.

Early Access Features

✅ Single-player and multiplayer battles against AI or human opponents
✅ Multiple maps featuring dynamic environments
✅ Co-op PvE for team-based engagements against AI

Future Roadmap: Syonix plans to add mechs, vehicles, aircraft, tactical and strategic mechanics such as AI squad movement, and a grand strategy campaign on a galactic scale providing a diverse range of accessible human, alien, and sentient robotic factions to play as and play against.

Join the Fight. Shape the Future. Scionide is based off the Scion Conflict 2267 AD book and universe by D.A Basque.

content_descriptors.notes: Violence depicted in the form of warfare and combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600 (Quad-core+)
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580 8GB
  • Storage: 512GB HDD (SSD Recommended) MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: CPU i7-12700 / R7 5800X
  • Memory: 32GB DDR4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU RTX 3070 (8GB)
  • Storage: 1TB NVMe SSD MB available space
